summary: Comprehensive architecture and implementation blueprint for SynthForge, a flagship hybrid software synthesizer featuring 4-layer sound generation (Virtual Analog, Wavetable, Spectral, FM/PM, and Multi-Sample), the Sound Morph & Transform engine, Motion modulation matrix, 8-macro performance system, scale-aware Musical Context, professional studio FX rack, interactive visual DSP oscilloscopes, and dual Play/Design/Performance workflows.
